title_en: Hey Girl, Why Don't You Come
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Лудо' is rendered as 'my love' (endearment); the refrain 'шеќерлија/леблебија' is my reading and approximate.

lines.en: Hey girl, why don't you come
to buy yourself a dress, my love.

lines.cyr: Три години, лично моме, шиен фустан стои,
lines.lat: Tri godini, lično mome, šien fustan stoi,
lines.en: Three years, pretty girl, the sewn dress has been waiting,

lines.cyr: три години, лично моме, во дуќан ми стои.
lines.lat: tri godini, lično mome, vo duḱan mi stoi.
lines.en: three years, pretty girl, it has been waiting in my shop.
Young lad, girl, oh the sweet seller,
young lad, girl, oh the chickpea seller.
Hey lad, if I come
to buy myself a dress, my love.

lines.cyr: Ако в' дуќан ти влезам, како ќе излезам,
lines.lat: Ako v' duḱan ti vlezam, kako ḱe izlezam,
lines.en: If I enter your shop, how will I leave,

lines.cyr: ако в' дуќан ти влезам, зло да не ме најде.
lines.lat: ako v' duḱan ti vlezam, zlo da ne me najde.
lines.en: if I enter your shop, may no evil find me.
Young lad, girl, oh the sweet seller,
young lad, girl, oh the chickpea seller.
Hey girl, if you come
to buy yourself a dress, my love.

lines.cyr: Ништо не ти чинам, лудо, само ќе те бакнам,
lines.lat: Ništo ne ti činam, ludo, samo ḱe te baknam,
lines.en: I will charge you nothing, my love, I will only kiss you,

lines.cyr: ако ми те бакнам, лудо, нема да си умреш.
lines.lat: ako mi te baknam, ludo, nema da si umreš.
lines.en: if I kiss you, my love, you will not die.
Young lad, girl, oh the sweet seller,
young lad, girl, oh the chickpea seller.
Hey lad, you tailor,
you want too much, my love.

lines.cyr: Венчај мене, младо момче, тогај ќе ме бакнеш,
lines.lat: Venčaj mene, mlado momče, togaj ḱe me bakneš,
lines.en: Marry me, young lad, then you may kiss me,

lines.cyr: фустан што ми сошле, лудо, невеста ќе носам.
lines.lat: fustan što mi sošle, ludo, nevesta ḱe nosam.
lines.en: the dress you sew for me, my love, I will wear as a bride.
Young lad, girl, oh the sweet seller,
young lad, girl, oh the chickpea seller.
